Your First Visit: Treat an Abrasion
1. Open the body chart. Select Begin Treatment on the settlement panel. Visible injuries are marked in red. Click a red area with an abrasion to open the wound details.

2. Drag the supply onto the injury and release. Drag rubbing alcohol from your inventory onto the red arm or directly onto the open wound picture. Release to see the abrasion change from uncleaned to cleaned. Repeat with any bandage to dress it.

3. Check the bill. The settlement panel only lists completed treatments and their charges. You can dress an abrasion straight away; cleaning first earns a perfect result. Cleaning alone is not billable. When you are ready to finish the visit, select End & Settle.
